raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next PLE table is currently sharded with attention TP, so lowering TP substantially increases its per-GPU memory. This adds opt-in EP row sharding for **frozen** n-gram tables, while retaining the existing logical weight/key and shared text/VL decoder. At EP32, the approximately 95 GiB BF16 table occupies approximately 3 GiB per rank.

**Draft, stacked on #6354.** The default TP path is preserved. Select `ple_embedding_sharding="ep"`, `ple_freeze_ngram_embeddings=True`, and `expert_tensor_parallel_size=1`. Dense PLE projections, norms and convolution remain trainable. Trainable EP tables, CP, graph capture and scheduler changes are outside this PR.

### Attribution

The owner-routed request/return all-to-all and forked shard initialization are adapted from **@BestJuly's NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7553**, specifically [`distributed_embedding.py` at `1ce7e86a073c18bcb6ea2ca5542c91e270d06a12`](https://github.com/BestJuly/Megatron-LM/blob/1ce7e86a073c18bcb6ea2ca5542c91e270d06a12/megatron/core/models/engram/distributed_embedding.py). Bridge preserves its single padded table instead of adopting the upstream multi-table representation. Attribution is also retained in the implementation and model documentation.

### Implementation

- Route only this rank's requested rows to their EP owners; support duplicate and empty requests. Hash complete sequences before SP slicing.
- Mark frozen shards as expert-DP replicas so ordinary dense-DP parameter broadcasts cannot overwrite distinct EP rows.
- Resolve HF import/export ownership from the destination module, preserving lazy shard reads and streamed default-dtype export. EP export broadcasts owner rows directly to preserve signed-zero and NaN payload bits.
- Describe the existing logical checkpoint weight using EP row offsets and expert-DP replica metadata.

### Validation

- Native NeMo 26.10.rc4 CPU preflight passed **70 tests**, including direct production imports, real four-process Gloo routing, all 17 new integration cases, existing Bridge/PLE tests, and private verification-harness checks.
- **TP1/EP32 passed on all 32 GB200 ranks** with the full checkpoint: exact local-row import, duplicate/empty/boundary lookup, streamed HF shard export, 4K hashed lookup, dense PLE forward/backward and update checks, and unchanged frozen-table hashes. A separate small native TP checkpoint was saved for the checkpoint-format resharding test.
- **TP2/SP also passed on all 32 ranks**, including full-table conversion/lookup and the separate native TP-to-EP checkpoint loading test. Full-model 4K TP1/EP32 Muon training completed one update on all ranks (loss1.9322, gradient norm11.6959), then exhausted GPU memory on the next forward. This is not a steady-state performance result.
- All pre-commit hooks passed; independent source review completed. Production source remains unchanged across the GPU attempts.

No 300 TFLOP/s result is claimed. The upstream 384–430 number uses an 8-layer, 32K-token GB300 proxy and additional kernel/graph optimizations; this PR initially ports the table distribution only. The following performance observation uses the full checkpoint rather than that proxy.

### Full-model performance observation

Job 8565127 completed 15 updates on 32 GB200 GPUs with sequence length 4096, TP2/SP, EP32, ETP1, CP=PP1, MBS1/GBS32, frozen PLE and Muon. No recompute, CUDA graphs or forced router balancing. After excluding the first 10 updates, the producer reports **4.214 s/update**, **31,103 tokens/s**, **40.88 estimated model TFLOP/s/GPU**, and **113.68 GiB peak allocated memory**. Loss moved from 1.93221 to 1.70620; retained gradient norms were finite (1.19370–11.33106).

Training exited successfully, but an output quota failure interrupted evidence publication. Independent review verified all 15 surviving final rank audits, including frozen-table invariance and Muon update checks; 17 final audits are missing. Aggregate performance remains provisional. This does not invalidate the earlier complete 32-rank correctness gates. The FLOP estimate uses the existing dense QSA surrogate, includes GR/PLE projection matrices, and excludes optimizer work and communication; tokens/s and update time are the primary performance measures. Parallelism and batch differ from the earlier baseline, so this is not an isolated EP-sharding speedup measurement.

 or held-out quality. The historical 8,192-sample, 5,349-step image SFT loss curve
 remains separate evidence.
 
+## Frozen PLE table sharding
+
+`model.ple_embedding_sharding="ep"` distributes the frozen n-gram table over
+the expert-parallel group, independently of attention tensor parallelism.
+Enable it together with `model.ple_freeze_ngram_embeddings=True` and
+`model.expert_tensor_parallel_size=1`. The default `"tp"` preserves the
+existing tensor-parallel table layout. Only the lookup table is frozen;
+the PLE projections, normalization, and convolution remain trainable.
+The shared decoder implements this option for both text-only and VL models.
+
+The owner-routed lookup is adapted from BestJuly's
+[Megatron-LM PR #7553](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7553), specifically
+[`distributed_embedding.py` at `1ce7e86a`](https://github.com/BestJuly/Megatron-LM/blob/1ce7e86a073c18bcb6ea2ca5542c91e270d06a12/megatron/core/models/engram/distributed_embedding.py).
+Bridge retains its single padded table and HF checkpoint keys rather than
+adopting upstream's separate table per hash head. Each EP rank owns an equal
+contiguous row range; the padded row count must be divisible by EP.
+Lookup requests and embeddings travel by all-to-all. Hashing precedes SP
+slicing so n-grams retain context across tensor-parallel boundaries.
+
+HF import reads the checkpoint shards overlapping each destination's row
+range. Default-dtype HF export streams one shard at a time over the table's
+TP or EP group. Requesting an explicit export dtype may materialize multiple
+shards through the shared conversion layer. Start a fresh optimizer when
+freezing a previously trainable table; this option does not migrate optimizer
+state from trainable PLE checkpoints. Trainable EP tables, ETP greater than
+one, CP, and CUDA graph capture are outside this initial implementation.
+
+This is a memory-layout optimization, not a throughput guarantee. The
+approximately 95 GiB BF16 n-gram table occupies about 3 GiB per rank at EP32,
+making lower attention TP practical to evaluate. The 384–430 TFLOP/s/GPU
+numbers in #7553 use a reduced 8-layer, 32K-token GB300 proxy with additional
+kernel and graph optimizations; they are not verified results for this port.
+

+"""Frozen EP-sharded lookup for Qwen3.8's concatenated padded n-gram table.
+
+The owner/request/return all-to-all protocol and forked shard initialization are
+adapted from Megatron-LM PR #7553, commit 1ce7e86a073c18bcb6ea2ca5542c91e270d06a12,
+``megatron/core/models/engram/distributed_embedding.py``:
+https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7553
+https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1ce7e86a073c18bcb6ea2ca5542c91e270d06a12/megatron/core/models/engram/distributed_embedding.py. Unlike that trainable,
+multitable implementation, this module preserves one logical ``weight`` and has
+no embedding backward or tensor-parallel reduction.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.mapping import ShardedStateDict
+    from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+
+class FrozenEPNgramEmbedding(nn.Module):
+    """Shard one frozen padded table by rows over an explicit expert group.
+
+    The caller computes hashes on full sequences, then slices sequence-parallel
+    token positions before lookup. Every EP member must call forward in the same
+    order, including members with no local requests. Expert-DP groups replicate
+    a row shard; dense TP ranks are not additional checkpoint replicas.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        num_embeddings: int,
+        embedding_dim: int,
+        *,
+        init_method: Callable[[Tensor], None],
+        ep_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+        expt_dp_group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if not dist.is_initialized() or ep_group is None or expt_dp_group is None:
+            raise ValueError("Frozen EP embedding requires explicit initialized EP and expert-DP groups")
+        if config.expert_tensor_parallel_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Frozen EP embedding requires expert_tensor_parallel_size=1")
+        self.config = config
+        self.ep_group = self.sharding_group = ep_group
+        self.expt_dp_group = expt_dp_group
+        self.ep_rank = dist.get_rank(ep_group)
+        self.ep_size = dist.get_world_size(ep_group)
+        if self.ep_rank < 0 or dist.get_rank(expt_dp_group) < 0:
+            raise ValueError("This rank must belong to both embedding process groups")
+        if type(num_embeddings) is not int or num_embeddings <= 0 or num_embeddings % self.ep_size:
+            raise ValueError("Padded n-gram table rows must be positive and divisible by EP size")
+        if type(embedding_dim) is not int or embedding_dim <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Embedding dimension must be positive")
+        self.num_embeddings = self.global_num_embeddings = num_embeddings
+        self.embedding_dim = embedding_dim
+        self.local_num_embeddings = num_embeddings // self.ep_size
+        self.row_start = self.ep_rank * self.local_num_embeddings
+        self.row_end = self.row_start + self.local_num_embeddings
+        device = (
+            torch.device("cpu") if config.use_cpu_initialization else torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        )
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty((self.local_num_embeddings, embedding_dim), dtype=config.params_dtype, device=device),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        # DDP broadcasts frozen parameters too: only expert-DP peers share this shard.
+        self.weight.allreduce = False
+        self.weight.is_embedding_or_output_parameter = True
+        if config.perform_initialization:
+            self._initialize_weight(init_method)
+
+    def _initialize_weight(self, init_method: Callable[[Tensor], None]) -> None:
+        """Initialize without advancing the caller's CPU or local CUDA RNG stream."""
+        seed = (torch.initial_seed() + 100003 * self.global_num_embeddings + self.ep_rank) % (2**63)
+        devices = [self.weight.device.index] if self.weight.device.type == "cuda" else []
+        with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=devices), torch.no_grad():
+            torch.default_generator.manual_seed(seed)
+            if devices:
+                with torch.cuda.device(self.weight.device):
+                    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
+            init_method(self.weight)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward(self, row_ids: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        """Return exact table rows in the input order, with shape ``[*ids.shape, D]``.
+
+        A validation bit travels with each peer's request count, so an invalid
+        rank fails the whole EP group before any request/value exchange. This
+        shares the existing count exchange rather than adding an all-reduce.
+        Duplicate IDs and zero counts are retained; no reduction changes values.
+        """
+        valid_metadata = (
+            row_ids.dtype == torch.int64 and row_ids.device == self.weight.device and not self.weight.requires_grad
+        )
+        rows = row_ids.reshape(-1) if valid_metadata else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.weight.device)
+        invalid = ((rows < 0) | (rows >= self.global_num_embeddings)).any()
+        invalid = invalid | (not valid_metadata)
+        owners = torch.div(rows, self.local_num_embeddings, rounding_mode="floor").clamp(0, self.ep_size - 1)
+        counts = torch.bincount(owners, minlength=self.ep_size)
+        sent_counts = torch.stack((counts, invalid.to(torch.int64).expand_as(counts)), dim=1)
+        received_counts = torch.empty_like(sent_counts)
+        if self.ep_size > 1:
+            dist.all_to_all_single(received_counts, sent_counts, group=self.ep_group)
+        else:
+            received_counts.copy_(sent_counts)
+        sent, received = torch.stack((sent_counts, received_counts)).tolist()
+        if any(row[1] for row in received):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Frozen EP lookup requires frozen weight and device-local int64 IDs in the global row range"
+            )
+        send_splits = [row[0] for row in sent]
+        recv_splits = [row[0] for row in received]
+        order = torch.argsort(owners, stable=True)
+        requests = rows.index_select(0, order) - owners.index_select(0, order) * self.local_num_embeddings
+        received_requests = requests.new_empty(sum(recv_splits))
+        if self.ep_size > 1:
+            dist.all_to_all_single(
+                received_requests,
+                requests.contiguous(),
+                output_split_sizes=recv_splits,
+                input_split_sizes=send_splits,
+                group=self.ep_group,
+            )
+        else:
+            received_requests.copy_(requests)
+        local_values = self.weight.index_select(0, received_requests)
+        returned = self.weight.new_empty((rows.numel(), self.embedding_dim))
+        if self.ep_size > 1:
+            dist.all_to_all_single(
+                returned,
+                local_values.contiguous(),
+                output_split_sizes=send_splits,
+                input_split_sizes=recv_splits,
+                group=self.ep_group,
+            )
+        else:
+            returned.copy_(local_values)
+        output = torch.empty_like(returned)
+        output.index_copy_(0, order, returned)
+        return output.view(*row_ids.shape, self.embedding_dim)
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(
+        self, prefix: str = "", sharded_offsets: tuple = (), metadata: dict | None = None
+    ) -> ShardedStateDict:
+        """Keep the original single-table logical key with EP rows and EDP replicas."""
+        from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.mapping import ShardedTensor
+
+        del metadata
+        if sorted(axis for axis, _, _ in sharded_offsets) != list(range(len(sharded_offsets))):
+            raise ValueError("Only prepended sharded offsets are supported for the n-gram table")
+        key = f"{prefix}weight"
+        return {
+            key: ShardedTensor.from_rank_offsets(
+                key,
+                self.weight,
+                *sharded_offsets,
+                (len(sharded_offsets), self.ep_rank, self.ep_size),
+                replica_id=(0, 0, dist.get_rank(self.expt_dp_group)),
+                prepend_axis_num=len(sharded_offsets),
+            )
+        }

+"""Real Gloo row routing and checkpoint descriptors, without CUDA/TE dependencies."""
+
+import datetime
+import importlib
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import sys
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+SOURCE = ROOT / "src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen/modeling_qwen4_exp/ep_ngram_embedding.py"
+
+
+def _module():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ep_ngram_under_test", SOURCE)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _checkpoint_imports():
+    """Load real Core checkpoint code without its unrelated CUDA package initializer."""
+    try:
+        importlib.import_module("megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.mapping")
+        return
+    except ModuleNotFoundError:
+        if "megatron.core" in sys.modules:
+            # Never replace a live Core package or conceal its incomplete installation.
+            raise
+    root = Path(os.environ.get("MCORE_TEST_ROOT", ROOT / "3rdparty/Megatron-LM"))
+    if not (root / "megatron/core/dist_checkpointing/mapping.py").exists():
+        raise RuntimeError("Initialize the Core submodule or set MCORE_TEST_ROOT for checkpoint metadata tests")
+    for name, relative in [
+        ("megatron", "megatron"),
+        ("megatron.core", "megatron/core"),
+        ("megatron.core.dist_checkpointing", "megatron/core/dist_checkpointing"),
+    ]:
+        if name not in sys.modules:
+            package = types.ModuleType(name)
+            package.__path__ = [str(root / relative)]
+            sys.modules[name] = package
+
+
+def _config(**overrides):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        **dict(
+            expert_tensor_parallel_size=1,
+            params_dtype=torch.float32,
+            use_cpu_initialization=True,
+            perform_initialization=True,
+        )
+        | overrides
+    )
+
+
+def _worker(rank, rendezvous):
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "gloo", init_method=rendezvous, rank=rank, world_size=4, timeout=datetime.timedelta(seconds=45)
+    )
+    try:
+        _checkpoint_imports()
+        cls = _module().FrozenEPNgramEmbedding
+        # Folded dense TP2/EP2: the two TP ranks own DIFFERENT row shards.
+        groups = [dist.new_group(ranks) for ranks in ([0, 1], [2, 3], [0, 2], [1, 3])]
+        ep = groups[rank // 2]
+        edp = groups[2 + rank % 2]
+        torch.manual_seed(781)
+        before = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
+        model = cls(_config(), 12, 3, init_method=torch.nn.init.normal_, ep_group=ep, expt_dp_group=edp)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), before)
+        assert not model.weight.requires_grad and model.weight.allreduce is False
+        assert list(model.state_dict()) == ["weight"]
+        initial = [torch.empty_like(model.weight) for _ in range(4)]
+        dist.all_gather(initial, model.weight)
+        assert torch.equal(initial[0], initial[2]) and torch.equal(initial[1], initial[3])
+        assert not torch.equal(initial[0], initial[1])
+        for dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16):
+            full = torch.arange(36, dtype=dtype).view(12, 3)
+            full[0, 0] = -0.0
+            model = cls(
+                _config(params_dtype=dtype), 12, 3, init_method=torch.nn.init.normal_, ep_group=ep, expt_dp_group=edp
+            )
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                model.weight.copy_(full[model.row_start : model.row_end])
+            ids_cases = [
+                torch.tensor([[0, 5, 6, 11], [6, 6, rank, 0]], dtype=torch.int64).t(),
+                torch.empty((0, 2), dtype=torch.int64)
+                if rank % 2 == 0
+                else torch.tensor([[11, 0]], dtype=torch.int64),
+                torch.empty((2, 0), dtype=torch.int64),
+                torch.tensor(rank, dtype=torch.int64),
+                # Caller slices positions AFTER full-sequence hashing; no TP reduction here.
+                torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.int64).reshape(1, 6, 2)[:, (rank % 2) * 3 : (rank % 2 + 1) * 3],
+            ]
+            for ids in ids_cases:
+                result = model(ids)
+                expected = full[ids]
+                assert result.shape == expected.shape and result.dtype == dtype
+                assert torch.equal(result.contiguous().view(torch.uint8), expected.contiguous().view(torch.uint8))
+                assert not result.requires_grad
+                assert torch.equal(model(ids), result)
+            # Frozen lookup still supplies the exact operand to trainable dense PLE.
+            ids = ids_cases[0]
+            dense = torch.nn.Linear(3, 2, bias=False, dtype=dtype)
+            output = dense(model(ids))
+            output.float().sum().backward()
+            expected_grad = full[ids].reshape(-1, 3).sum(0).expand(2, 3)
+            assert torch.equal(dense.weight.grad, expected_grad)
+            assert model.weight.grad is None
+            prefix = "decoder.layers.1.ple.ngram_embedding."

+            descriptor.validate_metadata_integrity()
+            assert descriptor.key == prefix + "weight"
+            assert descriptor.global_shape == (12, 3)
+            assert descriptor.local_shape == (6, 3)
+            assert descriptor.global_offset == (rank % 2 * 6, 0)
+            assert descriptor.axis_fragmentations == (2, 1)
+            assert descriptor.replica_id == (0, 0, rank // 2)
+            assert descriptor.data is model.weight
+            stacked = model.sharded_state_dict(prefix, ((0, 1, 4),))[prefix + "weight"]
+            assert stacked.global_shape == (4, 12, 3)
+            assert stacked.global_offset == (1, rank % 2 * 6, 0)
+            rows = [None] * 4

+        def failed_init(weight):
+            torch.nn.init.normal_(weight)
+            raise RuntimeError("initialization failure")
+
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="initialization failure"):
+            cls(_config(), 12, 3, init_method=failed_init, ep_group=ep, expt_dp_group=edp)

+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+

+def test_ep_row_routing_and_checkpoint_metadata(tmp_path):
+    mp.spawn(_worker, args=((tmp_path / "rendezvous").as_uri(),), nprocs=4, join=True)

+        )

+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from types import SimpleNamespace

+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit

+class _Source(Mapping):
+    def __init__(self, tensors):
+        self.tensors = tensors
+        self.reads = []
+
+    def __getitem__(self, key):
+        self.reads.append(key)
+        return self.tensors[key]
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return iter(self.tensors)
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        return len(self.tensors)
+
+
+class _Mapping(bridge.PLENGramEmbeddingMapping):
+    # Deliberately inconsistent TP and EP ownership detects accidental TP fallback.
+    tp_rank = 0
+    tp_size = 2

+    def broadcast_from_pp_rank(self, tensor, **kwargs):
+        return tensor

+    module = FrozenEPNgramEmbedding.__new__(FrozenEPNgramEmbedding)
+    nn.Module.__init__(module)
+    module.ep_rank, module.ep_size, module.sharding_group = rank, size, group
+    module.weight = nn.Parameter(rows.clone(), requires_grad=False)
+    return module

+    full = torch.arange(48, dtype=torch.float32).view(24, 2)
+    mapping = _Mapping("decoder.layers.*.ple.weight", "model.layers.*.shard_{}.weight", 8).resolve(("3",))
+    assert mapping.megatron_param == "decoder.layers.3.ple.weight"
+    assert not mapping.is_expert
+    source = _Source({mapping.hf_param[f"shard_{i}"]: full[i * 3 : (i + 1) * 3] for i in range(8)})
+    lazy = _aliases(mapping, source)
+    module = _destination(1, 4, torch.empty(6, 2, dtype=torch.bfloat16), object())
+    actual = mapping.hf_to_megatron(lazy, module)
+    assert actual.dtype == module.weight.dtype
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, full[6:12].bfloat16(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert source.reads == [mapping.hf_param[f"shard_{i}"] for i in (0, 7, 2, 3)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_shards", [0, 4])
+def test_registry_selects_destination_aware_mapping_for_split_and_single_table(num_shards):
+    mappings = bridge.Qwen4ExpBridge.get_lm_mappings("model.", False, SimpleNamespace(ple_layer_ids=[1]), num_shards)
+    tables = [mapping for mapping in mappings if mapping.megatron_param.endswith("ngram_embedding.weight")]
+    assert len(tables) == 1 and isinstance(tables[0], bridge.PLENGramEmbeddingMapping)
+    resolved = tables[0].resolve(("0",))
+    assert not resolved.is_expert
+    assert resolved.num_shards == (num_shards or 1)
+    suffix = "shard_0.weight" if num_shards else "weight"
+    assert resolved.hf_param["shard_0"] == "model.layers.0.ple.ple_embedding.ngram_embedding." + suffix
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rank", range(4))
+def test_single_hf_tensor_retains_original_key_and_ep_rows(rank):
+    full = torch.arange(48, dtype=torch.float32).view(24, 2)
+    name = "model.layers.0.ple.ple_embedding.ngram_embedding.weight"
+    mapping = _Mapping("decoder.layers.0.per_layer_embedding.ple_embedding.ngram_embedding.weight", {"shard_0": name})
+    source = _Source({name: full})
+    module = _destination(rank, 4, torch.empty(6, 2), object())
+    actual = mapping.hf_to_megatron(_aliases(mapping, source), module)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, full[rank * 6 : (rank + 1) * 6], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert source.reads == [name]
+    assert list(mapping.megatron_to_hf(actual, module)) == [name]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ep_size,shards,dtype", [(1, 3, torch.float32), (2, 3, torch.bfloat16), (4, 5, torch.float32)]
+)
+def test_lazy_export_uses_ep_group_and_exact_owner_intersections(monkeypatch, ep_size, shards, dtype):
+    full = (torch.arange(48, dtype=torch.float32).view(24, 2) - 19).to(dtype)
+    full[0, 0] = -0.0
+    full[8, 1] = -0.0
+    words = full.view(torch.int16 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else torch.int32)
+    words[15, 0] = 0x7FC1 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0x7FC12345
+    words[16, 1] = 0x7FE3 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0x7FE54321
+    mapping = _Mapping("ple.weight", "hf.shard_{}", shards)
+    ep_group = object()
+    global_ranks = [13, 4, 29, 8][:ep_size]
+    calls = []
+    local_rows = full.shape[0] // ep_size
+
+    def global_rank(group, owner):
+        assert group is ep_group
+        return global_ranks[owner]
+
+    def broadcast(tensor, src, group):
+        assert group is ep_group and tensor.is_contiguous()
+        owner = global_ranks.index(src)
+        lo, hi = max(start, owner * local_rows), min(stop, (owner + 1) * local_rows)
+        expected = full[lo:hi]
+        # Verify the sender really supplied its slice before the simulated broadcast.
+        before = expected if rank == owner else torch.zeros_like(expected)
+        assert torch.equal(tensor.view(torch.uint8), before.view(torch.uint8))
+        tensor.copy_(expected)
+        calls.append((src, lo, hi))
+
+    def forbidden_reduce(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("EP export must not reduce signed-zero/NaN payload bytes")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_reduce", forbidden_reduce)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_global_rank", global_rank)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "broadcast", broadcast)
+    exports = []
+    for rank in range(ep_size):
+        local = full[rank * local_rows : (rank + 1) * local_rows]
+        exports.append(mapping.megatron_to_hf(local, _destination(rank, ep_size, local, ep_group)))
+    assert calls == []
+    assert all(list(export) == list(exports[0]) for export in exports)
+    assert calls == []
+    width = (len(full) + shards - 1) // shards
+    for i, name in enumerate(exports[0]):
+        start, stop = i * width, min((i + 1) * width, len(full))
+        expected = full[start:stop]
+        owners = range(start // local_rows, (stop - 1) // local_rows + 1)
+        for rank, export in enumerate(exports):
+            calls.clear()
+            actual = export[name]
+            assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8))
+            assert [call[0] for call in calls] == ([] if ep_size == 1 else [global_ranks[o] for o in owners])
+
+
+def test_tp_import_and_export_remain_on_tp_group(monkeypatch):
+    full = torch.arange(48, dtype=torch.float32).view(24, 2)
+    mapping = _Mapping("ple.weight", "hf.shard_{}", 4)
+    module = nn.Linear(2, 12, bias=False)
+    source = _Source({f"hf.shard_{i}": full[i * 6 : (i + 1) * 6] for i in range(4)})
+    actual = mapping.hf_to_megatron(_aliases(mapping, source), module)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, full[:12], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_reduce", lambda tensor, group: calls.append(group))
+    mapping.megatron_to_hf(actual, module)["hf.shard_0"]
+    assert calls == [mapping.tp_group]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "sharding,freeze,etp,error,match",
+    [
+        ("ep", False, 1, ValueError, "frozen|freeze"),
+        ("ep", True, 2, NotImplementedError, "expert_tensor"),
+        ("invalid", True, 1, ValueError, "sharding"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_config_rejects_unsupported_ep_modes(sharding, freeze, etp, error, match):
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        ple_embedding_sharding=sharding, ple_freeze_ngram_embeddings=freeze, expert_tensor_parallel_size=etp
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(error, match=match):
+        Qwen4ExpModelConfig._validate_qwen4_exp(config)
+
+
+def _ngram_config(**overrides):
+    values = dict(
+        ple_ngram_size=3,
+        ple_heads_per_ngram=1,
+        ple_eos_token_id=0,
+        ple_ngram_vocab_size_base=17,
+        ple_ngram_vocab_divisible_by=4,
+        ple_unigram_vocab_size=32,
+        ple_seed=42,
+        ple_embedding_sharding="ep",
+        ple_freeze_ngram_embeddings=True,
+        sequence_parallel=True,
+        init_method=lambda x: None,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(**(values | overrides))
+
+
+class _Lookup(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, rows, width, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.arange(rows * width, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(rows, width) / 100, requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.ids = None
+
+    def forward(self, ids):
+        self.ids = ids.clone()
+        return self.weight[ids]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [1, 2])
+def test_ngram_hashes_full_sequence_before_sp_lookup(monkeypatch, tp_size):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple, "FrozenEPNgramEmbedding", _Lookup)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple.torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple, "get_pg_size", lambda group: group.size())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple, "get_pg_rank", lambda group: group.rank())
+    tokens = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0, 7]])
+    full_outputs = []
+    for rank in range(tp_size):
+        group = SimpleNamespace(size=lambda: tp_size, rank=lambda: rank)
+        model = ple.NGramEmbedding(
+            _ngram_config(), 4, 0, pg_collection=SimpleNamespace(tp=group, ep=object(), expt_dp=object())
+        )
+        ids = model.compute_ngram_ids(tokens)
+        actual = model(ids)
+        width = tokens.shape[1] // tp_size
+        expected_ids = ids[:, rank * width : (rank + 1) * width]
+        assert torch.equal(model.ngram_embedding.ids, expected_ids)
+        expected = model.ngram_embedding.weight[expected_ids].transpose(0, 1).flatten(-2)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        if rank:
+            local_hash = model.compute_ngram_ids(tokens[:, rank * width : (rank + 1) * width])
+            assert not torch.equal(local_hash[:, 0], expected_ids[:, 0])
+        full_outputs.append(actual)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        torch.cat(full_outputs), model.ngram_embedding.weight[ids].transpose(0, 1).flatten(-2), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+
+def test_real_ple_prepare_and_dense_backward_keep_only_table_frozen(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple, "FrozenEPNgramEmbedding", _Lookup)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple.torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ple, "get_pg_size", lambda group: group.size())
+    group = SimpleNamespace(size=lambda: 1, rank=lambda: 0)
+    config = _ngram_config(
+        sequence_parallel=False,
+        ple_layer_ids=[1],
+        mhc_num_residual_streams=2,
+        hidden_size=4,
+        layernorm_epsilon=1e-6,
+        ple_embed_dim=4,
+        params_dtype=torch.float32,
+        ple_conv_kernel_size=1,
+        perform_initialization=True,
+        init_method_std=0.1,
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(23)
+    model = ple.PerLayerEmbedding(
+        config, 1, pg_collection=SimpleNamespace(tp=group, cp=group, ep=object(), expt_dp=object())
+    )
+    model.prepare(torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4]]))
+    hidden = torch.randn(4, 1, 8, requires_grad=True)
+    model(hidden).square().sum().backward()
+    assert hidden.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(hidden.grad).all()
+    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+        if name == "ple_embedding.ngram_embedding.weight":
+            assert not param.requires_grad and param.grad is None
+        else:
+            assert param.requires_grad and param.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(param.grad).all(), name
+    assert model.key_proj.weight.grad.abs().sum() > 0
+    assert model.value_proj.weight.grad.abs().sum() > 0
